title: Reshaping Corporate Boards Through Mandatory Gender Diversity Disclosures: Evidence from Canada
authors: Jinshuai Hu; Mingyi Hung; Siqi Li
eligible_reason: Single-regulation DiD: Canada's December 2014 gender-diversity disclosure rule. Treated Canadian TSX firms vs entropy-balanced U.S. firms; areg n1pfdir2 c.treat1#c.post1 (+ controls) i.ry [pweight=_webal], absorb(gvkey). In dirfin_main.dta post1 = 1 for every firm from ry = 1 (fiscal years ending Dec 2015 onward); one common adoption date, so not staggered. Main columns also use entropy-balancing weights and time-varying firm controls.
design_notes: Stata (plus SAS for Table 1C). Firm FE + relative-year (= calendar fiscal period) FE; event-time version in Table 3 interacts treat1 with year dummies a4-a2, b1-b4.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: single common treatment date (Dec 2014 regulation); also EB weights and time-varying controls in most columns

data_files_note: README: dirfin_main.dta is used for all main tables.
screener_notes: Checked timing in data: crosstab of ry by treat1/post1 shows post1 switches on at ry = 1 for all treated firms.
